in_sanskrit.name: वीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A person who is known for his courage, valor, and strength

in_marathi.name: Vir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vir means sky, mountain or manliness. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vriyah' which means man, hero, warrior or brave.
